description: ISS external camera, Cat-4 Hurricane Milton over Gulf of Mexico, Oct 8 2024. Cut 0-75 s of 307 s original, 1280x720 (source max), audio removed. Generic "typhoon from space" (it is an Atlantic hurricane - do not label as a Korean typhoon).

notable_moments.what: 0-15s: whole storm disc with clear eye centre-left (~0.4,0.55), ISS module occupies right 30% of frame, black space top

44-75s: tilted closer view, limb diagonal top-right, eye visible as dark dimple at ~(0.33,0.4); solar-array edge creeps in bottom-left after 60s
